notes: robots.txt (jysk.dk/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow, only Disallow: /customer/, /checkout/, /b2b/, filters=*, sort=*, /search - proceeded. Direct HTTP fetch (curl) of the homepage and sitemap.xml worked, but the site is Next.js client-hydrated for product grids so counts were not present in raw HTML alone; escalated to Playwright (local headless Chromium) per access-tier rules, then cross-verified with a live Claude-in-Chrome browser session. Discovered the full seasonal taxonomy via sitemap.xml: a 'jul' (Christmas) branch with a parent hub at /jul (JSON-LD ItemList numberOfItems=11, matching its 11 visible sub-category tiles) and 11 named children, one of which ('julelys') is itself a genuine parent with 2 children (julelys-indendors, julelys-udendors), for 13 leaf/child nodes total. Searched sitemap.xml and site navigation for every other holiday keyword in the discovery vocabulary (paaske/påske [Easter], halloween, nytaar/nytår [New Year], valentin [Valentine's], advent, fastelavn) - all such terms appear ONLY inside /inspiration/ blog-article URLs (e.g. julegaveideer, vores-bedste-tips-til-fejre-valentinsdag-derhjemme, klaed-dit-hjem-paa-til-halloween), never as their own product-category URL; only 'jul' has a real /jul/... category branch with dedicated PLP URLs, breadcrumbs, filter/sort UI and CollectionPage schema. The main mega-menu 'Kategorier' list (checked live) currently shows only room categories (Soveværelse, Badeværelse, Kontor, Stue, Spisestue, Opbevaring, Gardiner, Have, Indretning, Entré) with no 'Jul' entry - the Christmas branch is reachable by direct/sitemap URL but not currently promoted in nav, consistent with being off-season. EVERY one of the 12 Christmas leaf/child PLPs (all except the /jul and /julelys grouping hubs) returned the identical, genuine result: embedded JSON-LD 'numberOfItems':0 and a rendered '0 varer' (0 items) product counter, with no product tiles - reproduced identically via curl'd static HTML, headless Playwright render, and a live Claude-in-Chrome session (ruling out a JS-hydration artifact). To rule out bot/geo blocking (this workstation's IPv4 egress resolves to an Indian ISP per ipinfo.io) as the cause, verified in the same sessions that ordinary non-seasonal JYSK categories load normally with full product grids and real images (e.g. /stue and /stue/sofaborde-og-sideborde rendered populated tiles and real product listings; /jul tiles showed only broken/placeholder images by contrast) - confirming the site itself functions normally and the 0-count is a genuine, site-reported state of the Christmas assortment, not an access failure. Recorded as qty:0 (a verified exact site-reported number, not an estimate) with a flag rather than dropped, since the category nodes themselves are clearly genuine (own PLP URL, SEO title/description, breadcrumb, filter/sort chrome) - most likely the 2026 Christmas assortment has not yet been published/stocked as of this run's date (2026-09-03). This matches the identical pattern and reasoning already recorded for Juttu Home (se115.json) in this same archive.
